blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos has revealed that he did not initially want to become a politician, as he once dreamed of wearing a white coat and working in a laboratory as a scientist. In a candid conversation with music icon Gary Valenciano on the season finale of the “Unshaken With Gary V” podcast, which aired on Monday, Marcos reflected on what his life might have been like had he not entered the country’s political arena. “The funny thing is, I’ll tell you what: I knew I wasn’t going to be a politician.
